newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RESEARCH ALERT - NatFoods buy recommendation.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - NatFoods buy recommendation.

text.p: Morgan Stockbroking was recommending National Foods Ltd as a buy after focusing on improving returns from the group's core dairy operations.
"Construction of a new dairy plant and the recent sale of NationalPak underlie the focus on improving returns from core dairy operations," Morgan analysts said in an investment report.
A decision regarding National Foods future involvement in the fruit juice industry was also pending, the analysts said.
"The poorly performing fruit juice business remains the unsolved target of a strategic review by management," the analysts said.

Meanwhile, construction of a A$57 million soft dairy plant would deliver an overall reduced cost base of between $11 million and $12 million as well as much-needed additional capacity and flexibility for product innovation, the Morgan report said.
Currently, the group's market share of white and flavoured milk was about 30 percent nationally.
"Further improvements in milk margins from recent price increases should result in a strong improvement for the full year," the analysts said.
Morgan was forecasting a post-abnormals net profit for the current year ended June 30 of $71.2 million compared with a reported $15 million in 1995/96.
Total dividend for the current year was forecast at a fully-franked 6.5 cents compared with a fully-franked 5.5 cents total last year.
At the time of the report, National Foods share price was $1.53 compared with A$1.66 at 12.50 p.m. (0250 GMT) on Monday, down one cent from Friday's close.
